title: 2003 AMC 10B Problem 2
statement: Al gets the disease algebritis and must take one green pill and one pink pill each day for two weeks. A green pill costs \(\$1\) more than a pink pill, and Al’s pills cost a total of \(\$546\) for the two weeks. How much does one green pill cost?

solutions.text:
Each day’s pills cost \(546 \div 14 = 39\) dollars. If \(x\) is the cost of a green pill, then the pink pill costs \(x-1,\) so \(x+(x-1)=39.\) Solving gives \(x=20.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: Two weeks is \(14\) days, so find the cost of one day’s pills
If a pink pill costs \(p,\) then the green pill costs \(p+1\) and \(p+(p+1)=39\)
